headline: The rocket launches on the first try now

recap.title: A week from countdown to a clean launch
recap.dek: The countdown learned to wait on Wednesday; on Thursday the rocket launched on the first try and shipped v1.0.0.
points: Launch reliability: three fixes under #7 took the launch from scrubbing to a first-try liftoff, and **Reach orbit** stands at 3 of 5.
The ground station joined the project: ground#11 shows the pad clock in the control room.
One rename, booster to stage, touched 40 files and changed no behaviour (#14).

sections.title: Launch gets reliable
sections.dek: Two fixes stop the countdown from failing for no reason.

lead.label: Why it matters
lead.text: A missed spark used to scrub the whole launch.

cards.headline: A missed spark no longer scrubs the launch
cards.plain: The engine tries again when the first spark misses.

cards.headline: The pad waits for the gyro
cards.plain: The clamps stay closed until guidance is steady.

cards.headline: The countdown is tested on every change
cards.plain: A test now runs the whole countdown each time code changes.

cards.headline: The ground screen counts down with the pad
cards.plain: Crews in the control room now see the same countdown the pad runs, so nobody calls a hold off a stale clock.
cards.tech: ground#11 reads the pad clock that #12 holds; `screen/countdown.ts` renders it.

cards.headline: Boosters are called stages now
cards.plain: The word changes everywhere; nothing else does.

cards.headline: The ground screen is easier to read
cards.plain: Two quick fixes pushed straight to the ground repo: a night mode and bigger digits.

rail.connects: All three launch fixes sit under #7.

parts.engine: It retries ignition when the first spark misses, and boosters are called stages now.
parts.launchpad: The clamps wait for the gyro before letting go.
parts.guidance: The pad now waits for it to settle.
parts.ci: The whole countdown is tested on every change.
